about: Read-only coverage of the UPSC Mains pack. Reviewed items come from data/mains-questions.json; fresh items are the unreviewed AI batch in data/mains-fresh.json.

optional.note: Optional questions are generated on demand for the subject the candidate chooses; they are not stored in the reviewed bank until a human promotes one.

language.qualifying: 25% in each paper; marks do not count for merit
